title: TldRegistry
description: Registry facts for a single top-level domain, as published by the IANA Root Zone Database.

tld.description: TLD label without the leading dot (IANA A-label for IDN TLDs).

type.description: IANA Root Zone Database TLD classification.

operator.description: Registry operator (sponsoring organisation) as listed by IANA.

country.description: Territory name for country-code TLDs; null for generic TLDs.

is_idn.description: The TLD is an internationalised (non-ASCII) label.

unicode_tld.description: Unicode form of the TLD when is_idn is true.

iana_url.description: Canonical IANA Root Zone Database page for the TLD.
